about: A native `details` element. The browser opens and closes it without a script, gives the summary its role, its name and its expanded state, and opens a closed details to show a fragment the address points into. Details with the same `name` form an exclusive group.

declined.about: The full error of a declined payment in a small details under its alert. A reader who needs the codes opens it, and everyone else reads the alert.
declined.description: The customer's bank declined the card. Ask them to pay with another card or to call their bank.
declined.heading: Payment failed
declined.title: Under an alert

faq.about: Three answers with one `name`. Opening one closes the others without a script, and every summary keeps its tab stop.

currencies.answer: Payouts go out in the currency of the bank account. A balance in another currency is converted at the day's rate when the payout is created.
currencies.question: Which currencies can I receive?

fees.answer: A standard payout is free. An instant payout costs 1% of the amount, and at least €0.50.
fees.question: Do payouts cost anything?

timing.answer: A payout created before 14:00 reaches the bank the next business day. A later payout leaves a day later.
timing.question: When do payouts reach my bank?

faq.title: Exclusive group

palette.about: Every palette in the subtle look, which fills the box.
palette.title: Palettes

refund.answer: A refund reaches the customer's card within 5 to 10 business days. The fee of the original payment is not returned.
refund.question: How long does a refund take?

size.about: Every size, closed. The summary is at least a control's height, the indicator is an icon's size, and the content pads on the inset scale.
size.title: Sizes

title: Details

variant.about: Every look, open. The looks are the collapsible's: a filled box, a raised surface, an edge, and none.
variant.title: Looks
